forms.submit_safety: Public MCP tools validate only. Live submission requires explicit confirmation and must not be attempted as a dry-run side effect.
Live submission requires explicit confirmation. Do not send production test leads.

form_validation.contact_policy: Every form has a dedicated required email field and one required field labelled Phone (or Messenger). The combined contact field accepts a metadata-validated phone or supported messenger handle, not another email address. A separate Messenger field is forbidden.
form_validation.source_policy: Exact allow-listed TurboApply host. Source and local previews remain same-origin and fail closed. Only the controlled six-form DevNet artifact stamps dev.turboapply.agency and uses the readiness-safe Internal Testing route; release browser QA mocks 12 desktop/mobile cases and sends no real notification.
form_validation.idempotency_policy: Suppress only the same recent submission key and same normalized content fingerprint.
form_validation.ai_fallback: Optional. Deterministic classification remains authoritative when the provider is unavailable or malformed. Identity and tracking fields are excluded, and contact patterns in the message are redacted.
